ns2:course.label: Intro to Edu Admin.
ns2:course.description: (EOL 450) Provides the basic common understanding of theory and practice in operation and control of schools useful to teachers and other citizens; analyzes both formal and informal influences on governance; and serves as an introductory course for prospective administrative officers and supervisors. Not open to experienced administrators nor to students who have taken any of the following (or equivalents): EOL 542, EOL 543, EOL 565, EOL 546, EOL 566.
